diagnostics.description: A local health snapshot for the API bridge and desktop runtime. It contains no provider credentials or prompt content.

diagnostics.contractHealth: The health check proves the local HTTP bridge responds; it does not prove a provider is reachable.
diagnostics.contractSurfaces: Thread, terminal, automation, and MCP surfaces expose their own live status and errors.
diagnostics.contractSecrets: Secrets, command output, and conversation content stay out of this snapshot.
